verdict.rationale: Missive's docs say teams can share accounts and configure who sees what (docs-74), have multiple people work out of the same inbox without stepping on each other's toes (docs-28), and manage team inboxes and shared accounts (docs-32, docs-44). Assignment keeps visibility for everyone (docs-6), and team spaces add shared channels (docs-19, docs-8). Community users report choosing Missive as their team inbox for in-thread collaboration (comm-3, comm-4). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how shared conversation state (read, archive, assignment status) syncs across teammates.
